boundaries: Shared geometry is owned by UI because both owned platform renderers consume it. The earlier graphics candidate would create a package dependency cycle: packages/graphics/package.json declares @repo/ui, so adding @repo/graphics as a UI dependency creates UI -> graphics -> UI.
Existing graphics radarLayout substitutes sample attributes, and the legacy flat UI renderer imports frozen primitives; neither is reused as the new contract.

The kit performs no data fetch, persistence, identity authorization, observer permission, cross-subject join, scoring or owner approval. The raw value and unit remain attributed to their supplied measure and perspective; plotPolicy is a caller assertion, not semantic proof.

No current radar business capability is established in the inspected Sanctuary API catalog. Product ownership, source schemas, identity and consent, history, offline writes/sync, deletion, export, and cross-person visibility remain open and subject to the horizontal API foundation constraint.

This is a synthetic presentation prototype. Existing mobile profile placeholder, legacy paths, flows and their working behavior remain untouched. Independent device/browser accessibility and live domain evidence are separate obligations.
